description: Fingerprints of the tested Windows x86 PD2/D2GL files and plugin, with activation and loader settings.
validation: All three Win32 Release suites passed standalone and with installed artwork/table/archive fixtures. Coverage includes all four native Fade modes, fullscreen wall/water alpha, center-band clipping, side-panel offsets, minimap bypass, seven-color defaults, independent settings and ignored legacy opacity keys. The local build was accepted for publication after offline testing; broad version coverage and sustained game performance remain under test.
gameTables: Automatically read from active installed game archives or direct overrides via native Storm; development fixture hashes are informational, not files to download. Missing/malformed geometry or layer tables retain native/per-area fallback. Missing marker definitions disable the affected shrine/event fallback; existing native drawing remains.
optionalMenuNote: Styling, color lists and boundary thickness controls require the profiled expansion menu and runtime layout guards. Unsupported menu layouts retain INI appearance settings.
